description: The methods, tools and strategies used in developing software in large and geographically distributed teams. Topics include: agile development methodologies, activities of communicating with the clients to gather and analyze requirements, project planning and estimation in agile projects, distributed version control, communicating across cultural and time zone boundaries. Students work in distributed project teams and experience global software development environments.

• Complete all of the following
    • Complete all of:
      • SENG265 - Software Development Methods (1.5)
    • minimum fourth-year standing.

title: Global Software Engineering
